title: AP2 inside UCP (extension dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate, v2026-08-25)
caption: UCP decides where AP2 artifacts travel; AP2 decides what they contain. The business advertises the extension and its keys in /.well-known/ucp, signs each checkout in ap2.merchant_authorization, and requires ap2.checkout_mandate on complete; the Payment Mandate rides in the payment credential token. Once negotiated, neither side may fall back to an unprotected checkout. This is specified; live use is unverified.
alt: Sequence diagram with Platform, Business, Trusted Surface and Credential Provider. 1, the platform fetches /.well-known/ucp. 2, the business lists the capability dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate and its keys. 3, the platform creates or updates a checkout. 4, the business returns the checkout with ap2.merchant_authorization, a detached JWS over the JCS-canonical checkout. 5, the platform verifies that signature before showing the checkout. 6, the platform sends Mandate Content to the Trusted Surface. 7, the surface returns signed mandates as SD-JWTs with key binding. 8, the platform sends the Payment Mandate to the Credential Provider. 9, it returns a token carrying the Payment Mandate. 10, the platform completes the checkout with ap2.checkout_mandate and the token in payment.instruments[*].credential.token. 11, the business returns the order or an error such as mandate_required or mandate_scope_mismatch.
